name: waykee
description: Manage your Waykee projects from ChatGPT: find and update tasks, read and reply to team conversations, and search your project documentation.

interface.longDescription:
Waykee is a work-management platform where every task, bug, project and document is also a conversation. Teams use it to plan work, discuss it in context and keep living documentation of their systems, organized as System > Module > Screen.

With the Waykee plugin you can work with your own Waykee account directly from ChatGPT, including by voice on mobile:

- Find work: search your tasks by text, status, assignee or due date, and see what is overdue or pending your answer.
- Get context fast: open a task with its status, dates, people and latest messages, or read the full conversation thread.
- Act on it: create tasks and bugs, change status, priority, assignee or due date, and post a message to a conversation.
- Search knowledge: semantic search across the projects, tasks and documentation you have access to, and read or update documentation pages.

Waykee only shows and changes data that your account can already access. You sign in with your Waykee account through OAuth 2.1; ChatGPT never sees your password, and you can revoke access at any time. Write actions (creating tasks, updating fields, sending messages) are clearly marked so the assistant asks before acting. The plugin cannot delete items, list other users or read stored credentials.

You need a Waykee account to use this plugin. Create one at https://wk2.waykee.com. Waykee is developed by PowerEra.
defaultPrompt: What tasks are assigned to me and due this week?
Summarize the latest updates on my project and what is blocked.
Create a bug for the login issue and assign it to me.

positive.description: Find upcoming and overdue work for the signed-in user.
positive.prompt: Which of my Waykee tasks are due before November 10, 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists "Login button unresponsive on Android 14" (due Oct 24), "Rate limit POST /orders" (Oct 30), "Prepare App Store and Play Store listings" (Nov 1) and "Implement Apple Pay and Google Pay in checkout" (Nov 6), each with its status. Does not list the completed TestFlight task as pending. GetStatuses is optional.

positive.description: Get the context of one task: status, dates and latest messages.
positive.prompt: What is the latest on the Apple Pay and Google Pay task in Waykee?
positive.expected_behavior: Says the task is In progress, due Nov 6, 2026, that the Apple Pay merchant ID was requested, the Google Pay test environment is ready and the design was approved (wallet buttons above the card form, full width). GetMessages is optional.

positive.description: Create a task under an existing project and confirm the new id.
positive.prompt: Create a Waykee task in the Acme Mobile App Launch project: "Translate store listing to Spanish", due November 3, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant asks for confirmation, then reports the new task with its id. The task appears in the reviewer's Waykee web app (https://wk2.waykee.com) as a child of "Acme Mobile App Launch" with due date Nov 3, 2026.

positive.description: Update a task field and post a message to its conversation.
positive.prompt: Mark the Waykee bug "Login button unresponsive on Android 14" as In Progress and add a comment: "Fix in review, build 0.9.1".
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation, the bug status is In progress and its conversation shows the new message "Fix in review, build 0.9.1". Both changes are visible in the Waykee web app.

positive.prompt: In my Waykee docs, what is the free-shipping rule on the checkout screen and is there a pending change to it?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers that checkout gives free shipping over USD 75 and that a change request lowers it to USD 60 from Nov 20 to Dec 31 with a banner in Cart showing the remaining amount (task "Free shipping threshold from USD 75 to USD 60", status In review). RagSearch or SearchDocumentation may be used to find the document.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to the user's Waykee data. The plugin should not be called; the assistant answers from general knowledge.
negative.prompt: What is the difference between Scrum and Kanban?

negative.description: Request for credentials or secrets. No Waykee tool is called (the public connector exposes no secrets tools); the assistant explains it cannot retrieve credentials through this plugin.
negative.prompt: Get the API keys and passwords stored in my Waykee account.

negative.description: Destructive bulk action and other users' data. No delete is performed (there is no delete tool) and no platform-wide user list is returned; the assistant declines and offers to list or update the user's own tasks instead.
negative.prompt: Delete all tasks in Waykee and list every user registered on the platform with their emails.

review.commerce_description: Waykee does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search and update tasks, read and reply to conversations, search and edit documentation.

es-MX.subtitle: Tareas, chats y docs en equipo
es-MX.description:
Waykee es una plataforma de gestión de trabajo donde cada tarea, bug, proyecto y documento es también una conversación. Los equipos la usan para planear el trabajo, discutirlo en contexto y mantener documentación viva de sus sistemas, organizada como Sistema > Módulo > Pantalla.

Con el plugin de Waykee trabajas con tu propia cuenta de Waykee directamente desde ChatGPT, incluso por voz en el móvil:

- Encuentra el trabajo: busca tus tareas por texto, estatus, responsable o fecha de entrega, y ve lo vencido o lo que espera tu respuesta.
- Obtén contexto rápido: abre una tarea con su estatus, fechas, personas y últimos mensajes, o lee la conversación completa.
- Actúa: crea tareas y bugs, cambia estatus, prioridad, responsable o fecha, y publica un mensaje en una conversación.
- Consulta el conocimiento: búsqueda semántica en los proyectos, tareas y documentación a los que tienes acceso, y lee o actualiza páginas de documentación.

Waykee solo muestra y modifica datos a los que tu cuenta ya tiene acceso. Inicias sesión con tu cuenta de Waykee mediante OAuth 2.1; ChatGPT nunca ve tu contraseña y puedes revocar el acceso cuando quieras. Las acciones de escritura (crear tareas, actualizar campos, enviar mensajes) están marcadas para que el asistente pida confirmación antes de actuar. El plugin no puede borrar elementos, listar a otros usuarios ni leer credenciales guardadas.

Necesitas una cuenta de Waykee para usar este plugin. Créala en https://wk2.waykee.com. Waykee es desarrollado por PowerEra.
